name: agent-workflow-bench
description: CI-grade regression testing for coding-agent workflows through Codex, Claude Code, and local runner evidence.

interface.shortDescription: CI-grade regression testing for coding-agent workflows.
interface.longDescription: Profiles a target agent workflow, uses the runtime LLM to understand it and generate benchmark cases, materializes executable cases, runs Codex/Claude-capable benchmark flows, compares matched baseline and candidate evidence, gates PASS/DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY/BLOCK outcomes, and produces explainable reports plus self-debug reverse validation.
defaultPrompt: Benchmark this agent workflow with AI-generated cases.
Run Agent Workflow Bench on this coding-agent workflow.
Diagnose benchmark blind spots with mutations.
